title: PNP: ASEAN Summit 2026 generally peaceful despite minor disturbances
summary: The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday described the overall security situation throughout the ASEAN Summit 2026 as generally peaceful, with only pockets of "minor disturbances".

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday described the overall security situation throughout the ASEAN Summit 2026 as generally peaceful, with only pockets of "minor disturbances"
"Generally peaceful with some pockets of minor disturbances," PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Allen Rae Co said at a press briefing.
Co denied allegations of police brutality raised by a group of youth protesters who staged a demonstration in front of Camp Crame earlier Wednesday.
He said authorities allowed the protesters to air their grievances and maintained that no police brutality occurred.
"Kagaya po ng palagi nating sinasabi, wala pong magiging pag-aresto kung walang magiging pag-labag ng batas," Co said.
(Like what we always say, there will be no arrests if there were no violations of the law.)
Asked about reports that around 300 protesters were arrested nationwide, Co said the PNP would still have to verify the figures.
He confirmed, however, that arrests had been made in the Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila and Muntinlupa City with cases already filed against those who were apprehended.
Meanwhile, Co thanked the PNP's partner agencies, members of the media, and the public for their cooperation in ensuring the safe and peaceful conduct of the summit. —RF, GMA News
